description: The position of an item, counted from 0; a negative index counts from the end, so `text[-1]` is the last character.
`seq[start:stop:step]` copies part of a sequence, from `start` up to but not including `stop`; it never raises `IndexError`.
A `str` never changes: `strip`, `lower` and `replace` return a new string, and no method changes the original.
`items.sort()` reorders the list itself and returns `None`; `sorted(items)` returns a new list and leaves `items` alone.
`[expression for item in iterable if condition]` builds a list in one expression, like a loop that only appends.
